examples.text: bilaṅgathālikam'pi karonte, saṅkhamuṇḍikam'pi karonte, rāhumukham'pi karonte, jotimālikam'pi karonte, hatthapajjotikam'pi karonte, erakavattikam'pi karonte, cīrakavāsikam'pi karonte, eṇeyyakam'pi karonte, baḷisamaṃsikam'pi karonte, kahāpaṇikam'pi karonte, khārāpatacchikam'pi karonte…

17977.meaning2: garment made of eraka grass of fibre

17978.commentary: (MNa) erakavattikan'ti erakavattakammakāraṇaṃ, taṃ karontā gīvato paṭṭhāya cammabaddhe kantitvā gopphake ṭhapenti. atha naṃ yottehi bandhitvā kaḍḍhanti. so attano cammabaddhe akkamitvā akkamitvā patati.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ rājāno gahetvā vividhā kammakāraṇā kārenti… bilaṅgathālikam'pi karonti, saṅkhamuṇḍikam'pi karonti, rāhumukham'pi karonti, jotimālikam'pi karonti, hatthapajjotikam'pi karonti, erakavattikam'pi karonti

17981.meaning2: plant Palma Christi form the seeds of which castor oil is extracted

examples.text: telaṃ nāma tilatelaṃ sāsapatelaṃ madhukatelaṃ eraṇḍatelaṃ vasātelaṃ.

17983.meaning1: log of the castor oil plant; castor oil plant timber

examples.text: āyantu pana bhonto ye tattha caṇḍālakulā nesādakulā venakulā rathakārakulā pukkusakulā uppannā, sāpānadoṇiyā vā sūkaradoṇiyā vā rajakadoṇiyā vā eraṇḍakaṭṭhassa vā uttar'āraṇiṃ ādāya, aggiṃ abhinibbattentu, tejo pātukarontū'ti.
telaṃ nāma tilatelaṃ sāsapatelaṃ madhukatelaṃ eraṇḍatelaṃ vasātelaṃ.

17987.meaning2: makes move, stirs; makes sound; raises one's voice

examples.text: manaso piyā hadayagāminiyo, vācā so erayati kaṇṇasukhā, vācāsuciṇṇaphalam'anubhavi, saggesu vedayatha puññaphalaṃ.
atthadhammasahitaṃ pure giraṃ, erayaṃ bahujanaṃ nidaṃsayi, pāṇinaṃ hitasukh'āvaho ahu, dhammayāgam'ayajī amaccharī.

17990.meaning1: name of a royal family of serpents
17990.commentary: (JAa) virūp'akkhehi me mettan'ti virūp'akkhanāgarājakulehi saddhiṃ mayhaṃ mettaṃ. erāpath'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo. etānipi hi erāpathanāgarājakulaṃ chabyāputtanāgarājakulaṃ kaṇhāgotamakanāgarājakulan'ti nāgarājakulān'eva.

examples.text: sace hi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena phareyya, na hi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ahinā daṭṭho kālaṅ'kareyya. katamāni cattāri? virūp'akkhaṃ ahirājakulaṃ, erāpathaṃ ahirājakulaṃ, chabyāputtaṃ ahirājakulaṃ, kaṇhāgotamakaṃ ahirājakulaṃ.
virūp'akkhehi me mettaṃ, mettaṃ erāpathehi me, chabyāputtehi me mettaṃ, mettaṃ kaṇhāgotamakehi ca.
idam'assa hatthiratanaṃ, erāvaṇo gajo balī dantī, tedāni ayyaputtā, cattāro vadhāya ninnītā.

17993.meaning1: moved; stirred; shaken; swayed; agitated; whipped up

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, brāhmaṇa, udapatto vāt'erito calito bhanto ūmijāto. tattha cakkhumā puriso sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno yathābhūtaṃ na jāneyya na passeyya.
kusumitasikharā ca pādapā, abhigajjant'iva mālut'eritā, kā tuyhaṃ rati bhavissati, yadi ekā vanam'ogahissasi.
sace na-eresi attānaṃ, kaṃso upahato yathā, esa patto'si nibbānaṃ, sārambho te na vijjati.

17995.commentary: (MNa) vāto vā paṇṇakasaṭaṃ eretī'ti vāto vā paṇṇakacavaraṃ ghaṭṭeti.

examples.text: tattha ca me, brāhmaṇa, viharato mago vā āgacchati, moro vā kaṭṭhaṃ pāteti, vāto vā paṇṇakasaṭaṃ ereti.

17998.meaning1: one of the four treasures of a Bodhisatta

examples.text: tathāgatassa pana jātadivase'y'eva saṅkho, elo, uppalo, puṇḍarīko'ti cattāro nidhayo uggatā. tesu saṅkho gāvutiko, elo aḍḍhayojaniko, uppalo tigāvutiko, puṇḍarīko yojaniko. tesu'pi gahitaṃ gahitaṃ pūrati'y'eva, iti bhagavā pahūtaṃ hiraññasuvaṇṇaṃ ohāya pabbajito'ti veditabbo.

17999.meaning2: supported on a block (like a threshold stone) or with feet shape like those of a ram
